**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position).**

No most-favoured-nation or best-terms mechanic exists anywhere in the Development and Option Agreement in either direction. Searches for "most favored/favoured nation", "no less favorable", "at least as favorable", "best price", right-to-match, right of first negotiation/refusal, and comparable third-party offer language returned no responsive clause; the only "favor" hit is the successor/assignee provision in § 13.2.2, which is unrelated. AbbVie therefore has no obligation to extend Harpoon terms given to third parties, and the preferred position ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is satisfied — no redline proposed. Caveat noted in the finding: several provisions are redacted ([***]), so the conclusion rests on the visible text.
